notes.author: David Revoy <https://framagit.org/Deevad>
text: For this new episode, I tried an original take on the classic 'a hero saves the world from the attack of a large creature'. This chapter closes the trilogy about Coriander's coronation and now Pepper is offially accepted and part of Chaosah. This is also the end of a sort of 'Season 3' in my mind. Under the story of this episode hides a deeper thinking about our small daily actions to make this world a better place. Sometime we don't notice any direct effect but as part of the bigger picture they can certainly have very large, hidden, effects. Maybe we all already saved the world twice today without even noticing it!
